correctedState:
`sandbox.credentials` is unimplemented as a settings key, deliberately and on the record: it is parity row **R19** (`2026-07-25-nessy-claude-parity-audit.md:690`), status ⏸, **parked by owner decision 2026-07-28** ("нужно всё разрешить, ограничения будут потом"), with the implementation plan retained at `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-28-egress-proxy.md` (Task 4 = `credentials.envVars` `deny`; `mask` deliberately fail-closed pending TLS termination). `2026-07-29-deviation-audit.md:218` records the `mask` half as parked; `2026-07-29-deviation-unit-5.md:279-283` records the block's absence explicitly. An earlier sweep raised the sibling `network.tlsTerminate`/proxy-port keys and they were dispositioned to the same parked row (audit `:478`).

The protective half of `credentials.files` nevertheless ships, non-configurably and by another name: `credentialDenyRoots` (`packages/session-tools-core/src/runtime/credential-deny-roots.ts:96`) seeds `deniedReadRoots` on every sandboxed command via `host-sandbox-settings.ts:61`, `managed-policy-resolution.ts:225` and `script-sandbox.ts:83`, covering `~/.ssh`, `~/.aws`, `~/.nessy`, `~/.gnupg`, `~/.kube`, `~/.docker`, `~/.npmrc`, `~/.git-credentials`, `~/.config/gh`, `~/.config/gcloud`, `~/.azure`, browser cookie/login stores and `~/Library/Keychains` — where Claude ships no built-in deny list at all (`sandboxing.md:271`). The genuine remaining gap is the env-var side (`envVars` deny/mask, `injectHosts`, `allowPlaintextInject`) and the configurability of the file side, both owned by parked R19.

`sandbox-settings.ts:321` is not a misapplied citation: it is an explicit, reasoned generalization of `settings.md:200` — the doc's only published nested-block tolerance row — to the `network` sub-block, with the same generalization made and labelled as such for `permissionDsl` at `managed-policy.ts:1164` ("the doc's only nested-document case").
